Introduction

Choosing the wrong skylift size is the most common (and most expensive) mistake new contractors make. Too small — you can't reach the work and have to re-book the next size up. Too big — you pay for capacity you don't need and may not even fit it through the gate.

This guide walks you through the four most-rented sizes in Malaysia: 9-metre, 20-metre, 24-metre, and 32-metre boom lifts, with real site examples for each.

Skylift Sizing Guide

9m Skylift — Indoor & Confined Spaces

The 9-metre electric skylift is built for indoor use. Zero emissions, quiet operation, and a chassis narrow enough to roll through standard double doorways. Use it for ceiling work in malls, warehouse high-bays, factory ducting, and atrium maintenance.

Typical jobs: HVAC duct cleaning, sprinkler-head installation, mall ceiling repaint, indoor billboard install. Daily rate: RM380. Operator and insurance always included.

20m Skylift — The Workhorse

The 20-metre diesel boom is our most-rented unit. It handles 90% of shop-front signage, AC servicing on commercial buildings, billboard installs, and tree-pruning along town roads.

It's truck-mounted, drives at full road speed, and deploys in under 5 minutes once on-site. Half-day pricing kicks in at RM500 (great for short jobs); a full day is RM620.

If you're doing typical "tukar lampu" or "pasang banner" work in Kuala Lumpur or Petaling Jaya, this is your default.

24m Skylift — High-Rise Facade

The 24-metre boom adds reach for taller commercial buildings, factory rooftops, and residential high-rise facades. Same diesel platform as the 20m, with longer outriggers for stability at full extension.

Half-day RM500, full day RM650. Often the right call for warehouse roofing in Shah Alam or factory roof inspection in industrial estates.

32m Skylift — Stadium & Billboard

The 32-metre is heavy-reach territory. Stadium light replacement, large highway billboards, tall industrial chimneys. Truck-mounted with full counterweight outriggers.

Pricing is quote-on-demand because access logistics matter — outriggers need clear ground around the chassis, and travel routes must clear underpasses.

Cost Comparison Snapshot

9m: RM380/day · 20m: RM500 half/RM620 full · 24m: RM500 half/RM650 full · 32m: from RM1,200/day. All include certified operator and insurance.

Half-day pricing on the 20m and 24m is the best-kept secret in the industry — perfect for a 3-hour signage swap.

Ready to Book?

Tell us the height, location, and job type — we'll dispatch the right unit. See all our skylift units or chat now:

WhatsApp Booking Now

FAQ

Can I use a 20m skylift indoors?

No — diesel units exhaust fumes and are too tall for most indoor ceilings. Use the 9m electric or the spider lift instead.

Do I need a permit?

For private property, no. For roadside work in KL/Selangor, you may need DBKL or MBPJ approval. Our operator can advise.

Conclusion

Match the height to the job, not the other way around. WhatsApp us with your site address and what you need to reach — we'll quote within 5 minutes.

Pengenalan

Memilih saiz skylift yang salah adalah kesilapan paling biasa (dan paling mahal) bagi kontraktor baru. Terlalu kecil — kerja tak sampai dan kena tempah unit lebih besar. Terlalu besar — bayar lebih untuk kapasiti yang tak guna, malah ada kalanya tak masuk pintu pagar tapak.

Panduan ini menerangkan empat saiz paling laris di Malaysia: skylift 9m, 20m, 24m, dan 32m, dengan contoh kerja sebenar untuk setiap satu.

Panduan Saiz Skylift

Skylift 9m — Dalam Bangunan & Ruang Sempit

Skylift elektrik 9-meter dibina khas untuk kerja dalam bangunan. Tiada gas ekzos, operasi senyap, dan badan unit cukup nipis untuk lalu pintu dua-helai biasa. Sesuai untuk siling pasaraya, gudang tinggi, ducting kilang, dan kerja atrium.

Kerja tipikal: cuci ducting HVAC, pasang kepala sprinkler, cat siling pasaraya, papan iklan dalam mall. Kadar harian: RM380. Operator dan insurans sentiasa termasuk.

Skylift 20m — Unit Paling Laris

Skylift diesel 20-meter ialah unit paling laris kami. Ia uruskan 90% kerja papan kedai, servis aircond komersial, pasang papan iklan, dan pemangkasan pokok di tepi jalan.

Dipasang atas trak, boleh memandu pada kelajuan jalan biasa, dan boleh disusun atur dalam 5 minit di tapak. Harga separuh hari bermula RM500 (sesuai untuk kerja pendek); satu hari penuh RM620.

Kalau anda buat kerja "tukar lampu" atau "pasang banner" di Kuala Lumpur atau Petaling Jaya, inilah pilihan asas.

Skylift 24m — Fasad Bangunan Tinggi

Boom 24-meter memberi capaian tambahan untuk bangunan komersial yang lebih tinggi, bumbung kilang, dan fasad pangsapuri. Platform diesel yang sama dengan 20m, dengan outrigger lebih panjang untuk kestabilan ketika boom dipanjangkan penuh.

Separuh hari RM500, satu hari penuh RM650. Selalunya pilihan tepat untuk bumbung gudang di Shah Alam atau pemeriksaan bumbung kilang di kawasan perindustrian.

Skylift 32m — Stadium & Papan Iklan Besar

32-meter ialah kawasan capaian berat. Tukar lampu stadium, papan iklan jalan raya besar, cerobong industri tinggi. Dipasang atas trak dengan outrigger pengimbang penuh.

Harga ikut sebut-harga sebab logistik akses penting — outrigger perlu ruang lapang sekeliling chassis, dan laluan perlu lulus ketinggian jambatan.

Bandingan Kos Ringkas

9m: RM380/hari · 20m: RM500 separuh/RM620 penuh · 24m: RM500 separuh/RM650 penuh · 32m: dari RM1,200/hari. Semua termasuk operator bertauliah dan insurans.

Kadar separuh hari pada 20m dan 24m adalah rahsia industri — sangat sesuai untuk tukar papan tanda 3 jam.

Tidak — unit diesel keluarkan asap dan terlalu tinggi untuk kebanyakan siling. Guna 9m elektrik atau spider lift sebagai alternatif.

Perlu permit ke?

Untuk hartanah persendirian, tidak. Untuk kerja tepi jalan KL/Selangor, mungkin perlu kelulusan DBKL atau MBPJ. Operator kami boleh nasihatkan.

简介

选错高空车尺寸是新承包商最常见(也最昂贵)的错误。太小 — 工作够不着,得加订更大的;太大 — 多花钱不说,可能连工地大门都进不去。

本指南介绍马来西亚最常租用的四种尺寸:9 米、20 米、24 米和 32 米臂式高空车,并附每种尺寸的实际工程案例。

尺寸指南

9m 高空车 — 室内与狭窄空间

9 米电动高空车专为室内作业设计。零排放、运行安静,底盘窄到能从标准双开门通过。适合商场天花板维修、仓库高架、工厂通风管道、中庭维护。

典型用途:HVAC 风管清洁、洒水器头安装、商场天花板重绘、室内广告牌安装。日租:RM380。每次都包含操作员和保险。

20m 高空车 — 主力机型

20 米柴油臂式机是我们最受欢迎的机型。它能应付 90% 的店面招牌、商业楼空调维修、广告牌安装、街道树木修剪等工作。

卡车装载式,可正常公路速度行驶,到场后 5 分钟内即可展开。半天定价 RM500(适合短工);全天 RM620。

如果您在 吉隆坡 或 八打灵再也 做"换灯"或"挂横幅"工作,这就是您的首选。

24m 高空车 — 高层立面

24 米臂式增加了对更高商业楼、工厂屋顶和高层公寓立面的覆盖。与 20m 同款柴油平台,但配备更长的支腿以在臂全伸时保持稳定。

半天 RM500,全天 RM650。常用于 莎阿南 仓库屋顶或工业区工厂屋顶检查。

32m 高空车 — 体育场与大广告牌

32 米属重型作业范畴。体育场灯具更换、高速公路大广告牌、高大工业烟囱。卡车装载并配有完整配重支腿。

价格按需报价,因为接入物流很重要 — 支腿需要底盘周围有空地,行驶路线需通过桥洞高度限制。

费用速览

9m: RM380/天 · 20m: RM500 半天 / RM620 全天 · 24m: RM500 半天 / RM650 全天 · 32m: 从 RM1,200/天起。均含持证操作员与保险。

20m 和 24m 的半天定价是行业内的最佳秘密 — 非常适合 3 小时换招牌的短工。

不能 — 柴油机会排放废气,且大部分室内天花太矮。请改用 9m 电动机或蜘蛛车。

需要许可证吗?

私人物业不需要。KL/雪兰莪的路边作业可能需要 DBKL 或 MBPJ 批准。我们的操作员可提供建议。

总结

translations.title: 5 Skylift Safety Mistakes That Cause Site Accidents
translations.content:
What's inside
  • Introduction
  • The Five Mistakes
  • Pre-Use Checklist
  • Ready to book?
  • Conclusion

Introduction

Skylift accidents in Malaysia are rarely caused by faulty equipment. They're caused by site teams skipping basic safety steps because the job feels routine. Below are the five most common mistakes — review them before your next deployment.

The Five Mistakes

1. Skipping outrigger deployment

"It's just a small lift, we don't need outriggers." This is the #1 cause of tip-overs. Every truck-mounted boom needs all four outriggers fully extended and locked, on firm ground, before the basket leaves the cradle.

2. Ignoring wind speed

Above 12.5 m/s (about 28 mph), boom lifts must be lowered. Many supervisors don't even check. A pocket anemometer costs RM80 — buy one.

3. No harness anchor inside the basket

The harness clips to the basket anchor point, never to the structure outside. If the basket falls, an external anchor turns the worker into a pendulum.

4. Exceeding capacity

Most skylifts cap at 230 kg. Two workers + tools + a roll of cable can hit that fast. Read the capacity decal before you load up.

5. Soft ground without pads

Outriggers sink into asphalt on hot days and into wet soil after rain. Use steel or hardwood pads under each leg whenever the ground isn't reinforced concrete.

Pre-Use Checklist

Outriggers · Wind · Harness · Capacity · Ground · Operator certs · Emergency lower control · Fuel level · Tyre pressure · Site permit

Run this list every morning, no exceptions. Our operators do it before every booking — your supervisor should sign off too.

Ready to Book?

Every Skylift Malaysia rental includes a CIDB-certified operator who runs the safety checklist with your supervisor. See our fleet or chat:

WhatsApp Booking Now

Conclusion

Safety isn't paperwork — it's five checks that take 90 seconds. Skip them and the consequences are not theoretical. WhatsApp us when you're ready to book.

Lima Kesilapan

1. Abaikan pasangan outrigger

"Lift kecil sahaja, tak perlu outrigger." Inilah punca #1 tergelincir. Setiap boom atas trak perlu keempat-empat outrigger dipanjangkan dan dikunci penuh, atas tanah keras, sebelum bakul tinggalkan kedudukan asal.

Di atas 12.5 m/s (kira-kira 28 mph), boom lift kena diturunkan. Ramai penyelia tak periksa. Anemometer poket harga RM80 — beli satu.

4. Lebih kapasiti

Kebanyakan skylift had 230 kg. Dua pekerja + alatan + segulung kabel boleh capai had cepat. Baca pelekat kapasiti sebelum naik.

简介

马来西亚的高空车事故很少由设备故障造成,而是由工地团队跳过基本安全步骤所致 — 因为工作感觉例行公事。以下是五个最常见错误 — 在下次部署前查阅。

五大错误

1. 跳过支腿展开

"只是小升降机,不需要支腿。"这是翻车的第一原因。每台卡车装载式臂式车都需要四条支腿全部伸展锁紧、置于坚实地面后,再让平台离开支架。

2. 忽略风速

超过 12.5 m/s(约 28 mph)时,臂式车必须降下。许多督导甚至不检查。便携式风速仪只需 RM80 — 买一个吧。

3. 平台内无安全带挂点

安全带应扣在平台内的挂点,绝不能挂到外部结构上。若平台坠落,外部挂点会让工人变成钟摆。

4. 超载

大多数高空车上限 230 公斤。两个工人 + 工具 + 一卷电缆很快达到上限。上车前读载重贴纸。

5. 软土地面无垫板

支腿在炎热天气下会陷入沥青,在雨后会陷入湿土。地面非钢筋混凝土时,必须在每条腿下使用钢板或硬木垫板。

Introduction

You hit 5 skylift jobs in a month and start asking — should we just buy one? This is the maths every SME contractor should run before signing a finance lease.

Renting Maths

20m skylift rental: RM620/day full or RM500/day half. Rented 80 days a year (a heavy schedule for a single contractor): annual cost ≈ RM50,000. Operator, fuel, insurance, depreciation — all on us.

Buying Maths

New 20m boom truck: RM450k–RM550k. Used (5 years): RM200k–RM280k. Add: insurance ~RM8k/yr · road tax + permits ~RM3k · operator salary ~RM3k/mo · maintenance ~RM10k/yr · depreciation ~RM45k/yr (year 1).

Annual fixed cost ownership: ~RM110,000. To break-even on rental at RM620/day, you'd need 178 utilisation days — basically full-time work, every working week.

The Break-Even Reality

Below 100 days/year of skylift work → rent. 100–150 days/year → still rent (idle days kill ROI). Above 150 days/year sustained → consider purchase, ideally used unit + dedicated operator.

Most SME contractors are in the 30–80 day range. Renting wins decisively at that volume. Browse our fleet for current rental rates.

Ready to Book?

Skip the CAPEX. WhatsApp us when you need a unit:

WhatsApp Booking Now

Conclusion

Buy when utilisation is sustained above 150 days/year. Below that, rental is cheaper, more flexible, and shifts the maintenance + operator overhead to us. Most SMEs in Shah Alam and KL stay rental-only.

Pengenalan

Anda capai 5 kerja skylift sebulan dan mula bertanya — patut kita beli satu? Inilah matematik yang setiap kontraktor SME patut buat sebelum tandatangan pajak.

Matematik Sewa

Sewa skylift 20m: RM620/hari penuh atau RM500/hari separuh. Disewa 80 hari setahun (jadual berat untuk seorang kontraktor): kos tahunan ≈ RM50,000. Operator, minyak, insurans, susut nilai — semua atas kami.

Realiti Break-Even

Bawah 100 hari/tahun kerja skylift → sewa. 100–150 hari/tahun → masih sewa (hari terbiar bunuh ROI). Atas 150 hari/tahun berterusan → fikir beli, idealnya unit terpakai + operator khusus.

Introduction

October to March is monsoon season across most of Peninsular Malaysia, and especially severe on the East Coast. Skylift rentals don't stop — but they do need extra planning. Here's how to keep work on track when the rain comes.

Weather Limits

Wind

Boom lifts must be lowered above 12.5 m/s (28 mph). Pre-monsoon mornings frequently spike past this — check forecasts daily.

Lightning

If thunder is audible, the basket comes down immediately. Standard rule: no aerial work within 30 minutes of last lightning strike within 10km.

Heavy rain

Light rain is fine; heavy rain reduces operator visibility and makes platforms slippery. Most jobs pause when rainfall exceeds 5mm/hour.

Site Prep for Wet Conditions

Outrigger pads on every leg. Check soil bearing — soft ground sinks faster after rain. Protect electrical work from drip lines. Pause during active downpours.

For factory roof inspection in Shah Alam during monsoon, we always bring extended outrigger pads and a tarp for the basket.

Schedule Buffers

Build a 25% time buffer into monsoon-season project schedules. A 4-day signage refit becomes a 5-day plan. The buffer absorbs short rain pauses without missing the deadline.
